description: A steaming office-green ceramic coffee mug with two cream wisps of steam and dark coffee visible; clean chunky silhouette.
A paper-white report sheet with folded top corner, green rising bar chart, three thick navy abstract short rules; no letters or numbers.
An office-green desktop landline telephone with navy coiled cord and large cream blank square keys, friendly rounded silhouette.
A teal cleaning spray bottle and yellow sponge, two little sparkle shapes; no writing on the bottle.
A cream paper envelope emerging from a green desk inbox tray, small red circular wax seal; no writing.
Two blank manila desk nameplates being swapped, two thick red curved arrows crossing between them; absolutely blank plates.
A sneaky navy-gloved hand planting one incriminating red coffee mug in an open manila desk drawer. Compact symbolic icon, NOT a plant or flower.
A cream report page half concealed behind a manila folder with a red downward arrow; abstract navy rules, no writing.
A tipped red coffee cup spilling a bold dark coffee puddle, a few droplets; clear simple silhouette.
A messy little heap of crumpled cream papers, a red mug and skewed manila folder. Three main shapes, readable small.
A navy desktop monitor with a large red padlock centered on its cream screen, two little yellow alarm rays; no letters or numbers.
A cream envelope wearing a mischievous red domino eye mask; one folded red corner. Strong simple symbolic icon.
A disconnected navy electrical plug pulled away from a cream socket, a red zigzag separating them; cable curls below.
A tilted cream salt shaker with navy perforated cap pouring a short stream of grains into an office-green coffee mug; no letters.
A small navy internet router with two antennas, three teal indicator dots and a big red broken wireless signal above; no text.
A manila office fuse box with a red lever swung down and a broken yellow lightning bolt; bold simple shapes.
A teal magnifying glass examining a cream document with a simple navy fingerprint spiral; navy thick outline.
A teal rubber stamp tool above a cream seal medallion with a teal shield and navy check mark; no letters.
A cream clipboard carrying three large teal phone handset symbols in a column, navy abstract horizontal rules alongside, no text.
A compact teal CCTV camera with a cream circular lens and a small green play triangle beside it; simple chunky silhouette.
A cream clipboard with three bold green checkmarks and a small manila bar graph rising; no text.
A manila stopwatch with thick navy ring, white face, two navy hands, a red short arc at top right; no numerals.
A large office-green capsule bean boss in navy suit and gold tie, stern big eyes and confident moustache, head-and-shoulders bust. Tiny limbs, no human skin or nose.
One calm half-open cream eye with thick navy contour, green iris and relaxed gently curved navy eyebrow, level zero suspicion; no text.
One open cream eye with thick navy contour, teal iris looking sideways and slightly raised navy eyebrow, mild suspicion; no text.
One wide cream eye with thick navy contour, yellow iris looking sideways and slanted navy eyebrow, suspicious; no text.
One very wide cream eye with thick navy contour, orange iris and deeply angled navy eyebrow, small red alarm ray on each side, strong suspicion; no text.
One alarmed wide cream eye with thick navy contour, red iris and pinprick navy pupil, sharply angled navy eyebrow and three red alarm rays above, maximum suspicion; no text.
A classic office-green capsule microphone on navy short stand, cream shine, two small teal sound waves.
A muted grey-green capsule microphone on navy short stand with thick red diagonal slash across it.
A green loudspeaker cone pointing right with two bold navy curved sound waves.
A pair of navy over-ear headphones with cream ear pads, crossed by one thick red diagonal slash.
A bright office-green traditional curved telephone handset tilted diagonally upward, small cream highlight. One isolated handset only.
A stamp-red traditional telephone handset horizontal with its ends turned downward, small cream highlight. One isolated handset only.
A green traditional telephone handset tilted diagonally with two pairs of curved yellow ringing marks either side.
